content_sections.heading: PDKV Akola Skilled Worker Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PDKV Akola Skilled Worker Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the PDKV Akola recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the PDKV Akola recruitment is कुशल कामगार (माळी), which translates to Skilled Worker (Gardener).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Skilled Worker (Gardener) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Skilled Worker (Gardener) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the कुशल कामगार (माळी) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a 1-year Gardener training course from an agricultural university. Experience as a gardener is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Skilled Worker (Gardener) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Skilled Worker (Gardener) position is Rs. 10,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the UR category candidates?
faq.answer: The age limit for Unreserved (UR) category candidates is 38 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Registration will be from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The venue for the Walk-in Interview is the office of the Head of Department, Department of Horticulture, Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Krishi Vidyapeeth, Akola, Maharashtra - 444104.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates of educational qualification, age, caste, and experience, along with two passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
